authority_boundary: The trusted coordinator records the actual current owner's quote and source message. Imported JSON, model text and approved=true never prove consent. This API is not an OS sandbox.

assessment_access.local_content: At most30 unique {id,kind,source,selection} records; kind path or observation; exact nonsecret fields/range/byte budget. content_read present exactly when selections exist.
assessment_access.disclosure: llm_content and sensitive_exceptions are separate unique exact selector-ID subsets of local_content. Sensitive local read does not disclose content without the same ID separately in llm_content.
assessment_access.authority: Actual owner scope authorization binds full descriptor digest/revision. Scope changes invalidate affected prior authority; legacy scopes retain exact previous serialization and rules. Empty roots are authorizable only for explicitly typed whole_device/specific_problem assessment.
assessment_access.capability: Coordinator-enforced read-only grant; no universal scanner, executor, OS sandbox or native adapter expansion. Fixed destructive/root/resource/private-output safeguards remain. Browser history/cache/profile/session content excluded by default; secret values and raw authentication dumps remain excluded.

storage.default_change: New namespace only; no discovery, adoption, migration or deletion of prior namespaces; exact backend/schema identifiers unchanged
storage.transaction: One atomic session.json contains validated state and chained events
storage.writer: Exclusive session directory lock and optional expected_revision
storage.evidence: Immutable owned bytes with exact SHA-256, scope, settings revision and UTCZ observation

private_storage: Exact private namespace/session/evidence/lock directories and all private records are revalidated. POSIX current-euid actual0700 directories/0600 single-link files, exclusive no-follow creation and inode checks before bytes; unsafe existing paths hold without chmod/adoption. Linux additionally requires read-only native fstatfs admission on reviewed x86-64 LP64 little-endian glibc2.x: ext2/3/4, XFS, Btrfs, tmpfs or ramfs only; unknown/network/FUSE/9p/DrvFs/NTFS-emulation hold regardless reported modes. macOS requires actual extended ACL absence or valid empty ACL through the shared native checker; entries/ambiguous errors/unavailable checks hold, with no native Mac test claim. Windows shared native owner/System/Administrators-only namespace/file security descriptors are read back and admitted, never repaired. Traversable repository/work ancestors allowed. Gates run before allocation/private bytes and live admission. No outside-filesystem fallback.

plan.review_rule: Two distinct independent reviewers separate from the owner, each approved for this exact hash and revision
plan.approval_rule: Exact current hash and selected action IDs plus actual current-owner quote/message; or bounded explicit expiring exact-target, adapter/payload/plan/inventory-hash standing policy. Permanent purge separately requires typed irreversible-loss acknowledgement for exact action IDs, plan hash, settings revision and scope.
plan.execution_rule: No command strings; coordinator calls fixed supported service adapters only after begin_operation succeeds

recovery_contract: Typed exact backup receipt, archive/manifest actual bytes and native identity, immutable completed restore receipt and actual mapped restored file bytes, plus exact owned retention record. Boolean flags cannot establish recovery.
recovery_private_read: Before actual recovery bytes, revalidate exact private output root and all descendant parents plus private created archive/manifest/receipt/probe file admission, then retain native identity/SHA/cap gates. Typed quarantined POSIX source files preserve their modes behind checked private parents; Windows quarantine files still need native private DACL admission. Public installer artifacts retain their separate contract.
purge_recovery_applicability: Integrated permanent purge holds originally unbacked quarantine. Recovery binding must equal the original quarantine's exact recovery_backup and recovery_verification receipts and action output root, with actual manifest source roots and root_id/relative_path/hash/size coverage of every quarantined original. Unrelated genuine backup/probe evidence cannot authorize purge; lower native original-attempt/outcome/current-identity gate and separate exact loss acknowledgement still apply.
operation_rule: Atomic per-engine registry gate allows no new ticket/dispatch while any registered session has outstanding mutating active/unknown or unreconciled failed/partial effects, including pause_pending/stopped. Action IDs consumed once, including failures. Actual behavior verification remains separate; this is not an OS-global lock.
pause_resume: Pause prevents new actions immediately. An active operation reaches its safe receipt checkpoint. Resume requires fresh actual outcomes and current scope; unknown stays held.
stopped_reconciliation: Stopped remains terminal for authority; exact late outcome/reconciliation of an existing unresolved operation may record actual results or keep_stopped effects accounting without reopening or relabelling historical failures.
quarantine_recovery: Only exact storage.quarantine_restore.v3 accepts patchcairn.quarantine.recovery.v3: exact native original attempt/outcome, retained file identity/content/mapping, no-overwrite absent destinations, restore-plan SHA and retention. No unrelated ZIP needed; this proof cannot cover repair/purge.
external_repair_limit: Current component/OS repair handoffs held: no supported component-specific rollback verifier or separately authorized no-recovery-risk policy. Ordinary file ZIP/probe never establishes OS/app rollback.
external_preflight: Only fixed local MSI/PKG/DEB handoffs consume the exact approved argv[1] path. Actual current owned artifact native record/hash (64 MiB cap), exact stable package target_id/version/channel/architecture/publisher/source/installation_scope, fresh typed publisher/signature and package-metadata receipts are required before ticket, plus actual protected-system consent. Manager routes without exact content consumption stay held; no generic executor or EXE/free-argv route.
scheduling: configure_schedule returns owner/proposal/settings-bound schedule_id; trigger_schedule requires exact current schedule_id and unique trigger_id. Reconfiguration clears activation and holds new collection/stages/actions; only matching due/catchup/expiry trigger activates, old IDs cannot resume it. Active operations keep original scope/settings and safe receipt, then need actual reconciliation. Paused/held/stopped work never silently resumes. Fresh postactivation operation preconditions required. No OS scheduler or duplicate active job/session; guided activation creates an owner checkpoint.
unresolved_settings_rule: Material setup changes refuse while any own None/unknown or unreconciled failed/partial operation remains. Exact no-op settings preserve original settings revision/scope/operation provenance. After actual evidence-backed resolution, normal invalidation may proceed; old receipts are never relabelled.
plan_registration_stage: Pre-apply assessment/planning stages only; apply/verify/complete checkpoints cannot carry authority to another plan. Failed/partial replan resolution explicitly returns to plan stage.

assessment_completion.api: complete_assessment(session_id, *, summary_evidence_id, verification_evidence_ids, owner_quote, owner_message_id, owner_id=None, source=current_owner_chat, expected_revision=None)
assessment_completion.gate: Active plan-decision stage, current exact authorized scope/current scheduled activation, resolved earlier checkpoints; no operation history, plan, approval, reviews or standing policy. Explicit actual owner finish intent; selected finish checkpoint remains required.
assessment_completion.freshness: Summary/verification900s, exact current scope/mode/job and actual summary SHA/evidence coverage; verification after summary registration, scheduled summary after activation. Boolean-only flags insufficient.
assessment_completion.result: Durable resolved assessment_finish owner/evidence record; stage complete, completed only after selected finish checkpoint. Reports completed assessment and recorded no maintenance action, never all-secure or unchanged-machine assurance.

restart_required.rule: Same consumed operation remains unfinished; no installer retry/restart executor/automatic restart. Exact private original3010 receipt8,000,000-byte cap and actual immutable boot baseline; actual owner defer/authorize with current scope/settings/plan and schedule_id/not_before bound. Protected continuation at proven installer-exited checkpoint preserves any pause for later work. Stopped permits only actual-owner defer/authorize accounting for retained exact original3010 effect, never resume/newplan/newaction/newticket/checkpoint/executor; actual late result preserves stopped. Forged/unrelated/ordinary decisions refused. Schedule replacement waits once actual restart verification is recorded until final receipt; prospective time cannot invalidate a completed boot observation.
restart_required.verification: Fresh owned actual boot transition after owner decision/agreed time plus exact selected target identity/version and ordered original behavior observations. Engine-derived boot_observed retires only restart uncertainty. behavior_passed requires all exact targets and checks passed; direct success and unknown->success revalidate. Failed/partial requires actual boot accounting and normal retained-recovery effects resolution/replan, preserving historical failure. No boot proof cannot be cleared by generic flags or stop; unknown stays reconcilable. Trusted coordinator supplies actual native observations, never an imported approval boolean.

cost: Only owned current plan/inventory facts; missing or mixed-currency costs remain unknown
